info.name: Bundle 3 MVP test cases (US_25) - Chester
info.description:
One folder per kept test case of the workbook B3_MVP_Test_Cases_v3.2 (sheet US_25): TC10 to TC19 the negative cases. Each request is named after the workbook step it follows (TCnn step n - ...); the workbook's column K and its 'Postman map' sheet list the requests for every step.

Set chester_base and the tokens in the environment. The 'run' variable is created automatically and makes every test patient unique, so the collection can be run again on the same Audit Repository.

exec: if (!t || Date.now() - t > 1800000) { pm.collectionVariables.set('run_started', String(Date.now())); pm.collectionVariables.set('recorded', new Date().toISOString().replace(/\.\d+Z$/, 'Z')); }

exec: pm.test('Action is an update (U)', function () { pm.expect(e.action).to.eql('U'); });

pm.test('Which system sent it: source and Submitted-by client', function () { pm.expect(e.source.site).to.eql('Client Registry (test)'); var t = (e.meta.tag||[]).filter(function (x) { return x.system === 'https://akhester.com/chester/submitting-client'; }); pm.expect(t.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(t[0].code).to.eql('cr'); });

pm.test('Both patient records are named', function () { var r = e.entity.map(function (x) { return x.what.reference; }); pm.expect(r).to.include.members(['Patient/QA-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('run') + '-KEEP', 'Patient/QA-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('run') + '-MERGED']); });

TC08 - Many events at once
TC08 step 2 - send one event (repeats until tc10_n events are accepted; waits and resends on 503)

exec: var code = pm.response.code; var n = parseInt(pm.variables.get('tc10_n') || '20'); var i = parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('tc10_i') || '0');

if (code === 503) { pm.collectionVariables.set('tc10_retry', '1'); pm.collectionVariables.set('tc10_503', String(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('tc10_503') || '0') + 1)); pm.test('Chester asked to wait (Retry-After present)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After')).to.be.ok; }); postman.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName); }

else { pm.collectionVariables.unset('tc10_retry'); pm.test('Event accepted (201)', function () { pm.expect(code).to.eql(201); }); i += 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('tc10_i', String(i)); if (i < n) { postman.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName); } }

item.name: TC08 step 4 - each submitted uid appears exactly once

exec: pm.test('One record per uid, none missing, none duplicated', function () { (pm.response.json().entry||[]).forEach(function (en) { en.resource.extension.forEach(function (x) { if (x.url.endsWith('audit-event-uid')) { seen[x.valueString] = (seen[x.valueString] || 0) + 1; } }); }); pm.expect(Object.keys(seen).length).to.eql(uids.length); uids.forEach(function (u) { pm.expect(seen[u]).to.eql(1); }); });

pm.test('Step 3: each recorded time equals the time sent', function () { var r = pm.response.json().entry.map(function (x) { return x.resource.recorded; }); pm.expect(r).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get('t20a'), pm.collectionVariables.get('t20b'), pm.collectionVariables.get('t20c')]); });

pm.test('Step 3: Chester received time is within a few seconds of the recorded time for an online sender (the sender clock here is the test machine)', function () { var e = pm.response.json().entry[2].resource; pm.expect(Math.abs(new Date(e.meta.lastUpdated) - new Date(e.recorded))).to.be.below(180000 + 10000); });
